Welcome
Scott Wilkie Primary School is a top performing primary school situated in Custom House. The school is a founding member of the ‘Agate Momentum Trust’. The Trust aspires to provide its pupils with a world class education.
Senior leaders have researched and implemented the latest most effective practices from around the UK and across the globe in order to provide the children in the Trust with a broad, balanced and ambitious curriculum that puts the child at the heart of their curriculum and learning.

Vision – Strive for Excellence
We are: one MAT, one family,one community
Resilience Scott Wilkie pupils always try their best and never give up. I persevere when I am faced with challenges. I do my best to achieve excellence.
Care Scott Wilkie pupils care, share and are friendly. I take care of myself, others, my school and the environment around me.
Respect Scott Wilkie pupils respect each other and celebrate diversity. I treat others the same way I want to be treated. I appreciate that each of us is different!
Resilience ♦ Care ♦ Respect IN EVERYTHING WE DO!

Universal Free Breakfast Club for all (Reception to Year 6) From 8:00am until the class time starts. Nutritious breakfast provided.
Extended Provision: After school fun! From 3:30pm to 6:00pm. Only £15.00 per session. Activities, games, and more!
Wraparound Care at Scott Wilkie from Reception to Year 6
From 8am to 6pm for £15.00 per day during term time.
To book or for more information, please contact the school office: 02074744138 or email at info@scottwilkie.newham.sch.uk.
Tax-Free Childcare: We’re Registered!
We are a registered childcare provider, meaning you can use the government’s Tax-Free Childcare scheme to help with costs!

There are different arrangements for children starting our school for the first time and for children joining at a later date. The Local Authority’s Determined Arrangements have been adopted by the governing body of this Multi Academy Trust.
Below you will see guidance from the borough of Newham with regard to applying for both Reception and Secondary School for your child. We hope this helps. If you have any further queries, please do not hesitate to contact the school.
The law requires that each local authority must have a Fair Access Protocol (FAP), agreed with the majority of schools in its area to ensure that for In Year admissions unplaced children, especially the most vulnerable, are offered a place at a suitable school as quickly as possible.
In agreeing a protocol, the local authority must ensure that no school – including those with available places is asked to take a disproportionate number of children who have been excluded from other schools, or who have challenging behavior. Scott Wilkie primary school has signed up to the LB Newham’s Fair Access Protocol.
Nursery Admissions
We accept children’s names for the Nursery waiting list from their second birthday. We cannot guarantee you a place however we do try to offer all children at least three terms in the Nursery before entry to our school.
We offer most children a morning only Nursery placement or an afternoon only placement. To support working parents that are eligible we have a limited number of 30 hour places.
If you would like to put your child’s name on our Nursery waiting list we suggest you do this after their second birthday. Please come to the school office to put your child’s name down.
Please bring with you:
Nursery expression of interest form
Starting school for the first time
In Newham, children start primary school (Reception) in the school year during which they have their fifth birthday.
For children born between 1 September 2022 and 31 August 2023, their parents or carers must apply for them to start an Infant or primary school (reception class) in September 2027.
The closing date is 15 January 2027.
For information about applying for any other year groups in a primary, infant or junior school, go to our In year admissions page.
For more information please visit the primary school admissions page on the Newham website.
In the term before your child’s admission is due, you will hear from Newham to let you know whether a place is available or not. If you are offered a place, write or call to accept it as soon as possible.
After this, Newham Education Department let us know you have a place and we will get in contact with you as soon as we can to arrange an admission interview.

Determined Admission Arrangements
The law requires that all schools must have admission arrangements that clearly set out how children will be admitted, including the criteria that will be applied if there are more applications than places at the school. Admission arrangements are determined by admission authorities.
This school is an academy and part of Agate Momentum Trust which means we are our own admission authority. Scott Wilkie and Hallsville’s governing body have formally agreed to adopt the London Borough of Newham’s Admission Arrangements for September 2027 and September 2028 entry.
